titulo: Shackled men in 2,600-year-old Greek mass graves were likely locals, archaeologists find
cuerpo: In 2016, archaeologists working at the Phaleron Burial Ground, part of the ancient Attica region, uncovered an astonishing sight: three mass graves dating to the 7th and 6th centuries BCE containing the skeletons of 79 adult men. Many were bound together with metal shackles.
